roles.label: Owner
roles.description: Full access to all enterprises in the portfolio, billing, and user management.

roles.label: Manager
roles.description: Full operational access to a single enterprise; cannot manage billing.

roles.label: Front Desk
roles.description: Can create and modify reservations and update resource state.

roles.label: Housekeeping
roles.description: Can update resource state only (available, out-of-service).

roles.label: Reporting Viewer
roles.description: Read-only access to reports and reservation history. Added in 2.4.0.
